card.name: Space after 'every' before dosing interval
card.fires_on: The space token right after 'every' (or 'for the first') in dosing schedules, just before a number of weeks or days. Seen mostly in oncology infusion regimens.

modes.label: Every N weeks
modes.description: Space after 'every' before an interval such as 3 weeks or 14 days in IV cancer drug dosing.
modes.example: The recommended dose of KADCYLA is 3.6 mg/kg given as an intravenous infusion every<< >>3 weeks (21-day cycle)

modes.label: Duration phrases
modes.description: Space before a count of days or weeks after 'for' or 'for the first'.
modes.example: taken once daily with or without food for<< >>21 consecutive days followed by 7

card.plain: It marks the spot where a number of weeks or days is about to follow in a dosing schedule.
